boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus-specific places for quiet work, group projects, student organizations, recreation, gaming, and encounters with art on Florida Atlantic University's Boca Raton campus.

cards.entity_name: S.E. Wimberly Library Fourth Floor East
cards.title: Settle Into the Fourth-Floor Silent Zone
cards.subtitle: A designated silent-study area inside S.E. Wimberly Library
cards.notes: Head to Fourth Floor East when you need sustained quiet; choose a study carrel with power and keep conversation for another floor.
cards.short_summary: The library identifies this floor section as a silent zone, with study carrels, outlets, comfortable chairs, and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: FAU Libraries designates Fourth Floor East as a silent-study area and documents its study carrels, electrical outlets, comfortable seating, and increased natural light.
cards.source_title: Wimberly Library’s Fourth Floor Gets a Modern Makeover
cards.access_notes: Use during S.E. Wimberly Library operating hours; Fourth Floor East is designated for silent study.

cards.entity_name: S.E. Wimberly Library Third-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Third-Floor Collaboration Room
cards.subtitle: Bookable rooms for small-group work in S.E. Wimberly Library
cards.notes: Reserve online before meeting your group, then have two listed participants swipe their Owl Cards consecutively at the room.
cards.short_summary: Ten third-floor rooms provide reservable space for collaborative work by eligible Florida Atlantic and PBSC users.
cards.evidence_claim: FAU Libraries lists ten third-floor study rooms available through online reservation and says access requires two participants on the reservation to swipe their Owl Cards.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current Florida Atlantic students, faculty, and staff; advance reservation and two-person Owl Card access are required.

cards.entity_name: S.E. Wimberly Library Video Conference Suites
cards.title: Take a Virtual Interview in a Conference Suite
cards.subtitle: Two private fifth-floor rooms equipped for video calls
cards.notes: Reserve a one-hour session for an advising call, interview, or remote project meeting, then collect and return the key at the service desk.
cards.short_summary: These two fifth-floor suites give students a private, camera-equipped setting for academic and professional video meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: FAU Libraries provides two reservable fifth-floor conference suites with webcams and conferencing software for student virtual meetings, advising appointments, interviews, and remote projects.
cards.source_title: Book a Video Conferencing Room for Virtual Meetings
cards.access_notes: Students may reserve one suite for individual use for one hour per day and must obtain the key from the library service desk.

cards.title: Bring a Multimedia Project to the Sandbox
cards.subtitle: A technology-focused space in Wimberly Library, room LY 103
cards.notes: Check the Sandbox program or event details before visiting, and use the named library room as a meeting point for technology-centered work.
cards.short_summary: The Gruber Sandbox is a clearly identified Wimberly Library space used for technology programming and special events.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic identifies the Rubin and Cindy Gruber Sandbox as a space in Wimberly Library on the Boca Raton campus, and FAU Libraries locates it in room LY 103.
cards.access_notes: Located in S.E. Wimberly Library, room LY 103; availability may depend on scheduled programs or events.

cards.entity_name: Student Union Esports Arena and Gaming Center
cards.title: Check Out a Game With Your Owl Card
cards.subtitle: Computers, console games, billiards, table tennis, and board games
cards.notes: Bring your Owl Card for a free checkout, choose a PC or tabletop activity, and confirm the posted schedule because events can alter access.
cards.short_summary: The Student Union gaming center gives Florida Atlantic students several free ways to play or meet between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic says the Esports Arena and Gaming Center is free for its students, with Owl Card checkouts and gaming PCs, billiards, table tennis, and board games.
cards.access_notes: Fall hours are listed as noon–10 p.m. daily, subject to events, holidays, and other changes; free checkout requires an Owl Card.

cards.entity_name: Coconut Palm and Tiger Palm Meeting Areas
cards.title: Meet Behind the Glass in the Union Lobby
cards.subtitle: Two technology-equipped collaborative areas in the Student Union
cards.notes: Use these lobby meeting areas for a compact group session; contact Union Event Planning first if you need guaranteed or event-specific access.
cards.short_summary: Coconut Palm and Tiger Palm are named collaborative meeting spaces with configurable seating and built-in presentation technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic describes Coconut Palm and Tiger Palm as two collaborative meeting areas in the Student Union Main Lobby with customizable seating and built-in technology.
cards.access_notes: These are Student Union meeting areas; reservations or event scheduling may control availability.

cards.title: Build Your Organization’s Next Event Here
cards.subtitle: The registered-student-organization resource center in Student Union room 227
cards.notes: Bring an organization task such as promotion or event planning, then use the workstations or ask staff for one-on-one guidance.
cards.short_summary: The Club House gives registered student organizations a central workspace, practical resources, and staff consultation.
cards.evidence_claim: FAU Student Involvement identifies The Club House in Student Union room 227 as a resource center offering registered organizations workstations, promotional resources, and guidance.
cards.access_notes: Intended for registered student organizations; the posted schedule is Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Use the Rec Center Beyond the Weight Room
cards.subtitle: A 77,000-square-foot recreation facility at the north end of the Breezeway
cards.notes: Enter through the main facility, verify your eligibility or membership, and check the current schedule before planning a workout or court session.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation hub anchors multiple student activities and offers indoor fitness and recreation space beside the Breezeway.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic places the 77,000-square-foot Recreation and Fitness Center at the northeast entrance of the Breezeway and identifies it as a campus recreation facility.
cards.access_notes: Entry is subject to current student eligibility or an appropriate Campus Recreation membership; consult current operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Climb Above the Breezeway for Student Art
cards.subtitle: A University Galleries exhibition space on the Breezeway’s second floor
cards.notes: Follow the Ritter signs and stairs from the Breezeway, then check the current exhibition listing so your visit lands during an active show.
cards.short_summary: Ritter presents rotating exhibitions, including student degree shows and university-wide projects, in an easily photographed gallery setting.
cards.evidence_claim: FAU University Galleries identifies Ritter Art Gallery as an exhibition venue and documents student BFA exhibitions and university research-art displays there.
cards.access_notes: Regular posted hours are Tuesday–Friday 1–4 p.m. and Saturday 1–5 p.m.; closed Sunday and Monday. Confirm that an exhibition is on view.

cards.title: Catch an Exhibition Along the Public-Space Gallery
cards.subtitle: An exhibition area adjoining Schmidt Center Gallery
cards.notes: Pair this space with the main Schmidt gallery, and check the exhibition page first because installations and summer access change by program.
cards.short_summary: The public-space gallery hosts student, faculty, and visiting exhibitions in a circulation area connected to Florida Atlantic’s arts complex.
cards.evidence_claim: FAU University Galleries names Schmidt Center Gallery Public Space as an exhibition venue and documents student, faculty, and visiting exhibitions presented there.
cards.access_notes: Check the current exhibition schedule; regular gallery hours are Tuesday–Friday 1–4 p.m. and Saturday 1–5 p.m., with separate summer arrangements.
